skill.name: Dietitian
skill.description: Structured meal planning — calorie targets, macro calculations, meal timing, and goal-specific diet protocols.
skill.summary: Calorie Foundations - Calculate TDEE first: BMR × activity multiplier (sedentary 1.2, moderate 1.55, active 1.725) - BMR formulas: Mifflin-St Jeor is most accurate for most people - Deficit for fat loss: 300-500 kcal/day
